note: The inspectable module register (MODULE_PROJECTS_PLAN mp-1/mp-2). kind: official (maintained here) | vendor (third-party remote) | self (made on this instance from your own objects). downloaded: is the code locally present — module_registry.sync() re-derives this from the filesystem on every read, so the flag can never lie. repo: the module's own git remote once it is split into a sub-project (mp-2); '' means it still ships with this checkout. path: where the code lives TODAY (framework root until its mp-4 wave moves it into modules/). requires: other feature modules whose code this one imports — pol modules drop refuses while a dependent is downloaded. required_by_core: the core still imports this statically (module_gating CORE_PACKAGES) — it may MOVE into modules/ but cannot be dropped. wave: the planned mp-4 migration wave (0 = already moved). pol CLI: `pol modules registry | get <m> | drop <m> | publish <m> | register <m>`.

household.description: Household layer: people's schedules and sleep, members and work shares, skills and safety, dish strategies, the allocation and fairness

mealoptions.description: Meal options: templates, variations, recipes, steps, ingredient affinities, cooking methods, tool and task vocabularies, meal situations, bulk staples — the shareable meal data; no person or place data

nutrition.description: Dietary nutrients, person/household profiling, harvest -> meal-nutrient yield.

tanks.description: Freshwater/saltwater tank ecosystems — the alternate nutrient source.

plant_morphology.description: 3D organ + root stand-in models, confinement/dwarfing assessment.

bizops.description: Business operations: setup/upgrade flows, local-economy track, order planner with mold-ladder reuse.

odooconnect.description: Odoo ERP connector: JSON-RPC client with sim/ops write guards, instance configs, /api/odoo status.

waxsupply.description: Bio wax sources for molds and electronic masks.

supplychain.description: Unifying bio supply-chain ledger — materials + food + carbon accounting.

dmvdata.description: DMV cost-of-living source catalogs, gov/legal sources, cross-validation.

mathshapes.description: Math-defined shapes (quadric/primitive/CSG), aquaponic towers, CAD import.

electrodevice.description: Material-derived electronic devices, SPICE cards, circuits/breadboards as rows.

hwdigital.description: Logic diagrams as rows -> generated artifacts (iCE40 bitstreams).

hwfpga.description: FPGA register maps as data; Verilog/C/testbench artifacts from rows.

zones.description: AR-captured 3D zones: planar/hull models, rooms vs selections, cube packing.

xr.description: XR settings cascade + interface variants. Moves in wave 4; core still imports it statically (drop refuses).

aquaponics.description: Self-watering pots, FEM hydraulics, vermicompost, per-part plant growth.

grpcbridge.description: gRPC contracts from stabilized schemas, Java hardware bridges, hw sim rigs.

resources.description: Node resource inventory, module profiles, admission advisor. Moves in wave 5; core still imports it statically (drop refuses).

waxprint.description: Pellet-fed auger-screw wax printer: melt/bead-voxel/movement sim + optimizer.

scoring.description: Context-based scoring engine + epistemics stack (terms, proofs, credibility, authority).

techtree.description: Tech trees with theory/real/business/politics segments; OSEB baseline rollup.

polariapps.description: Polari-Apps: module configurations per use-case, plan-first + exportable.

testing.description: Accountability spine (opt-in: registers only on test builds / explicit POLARI_MODULES).

pspp.description: PSPP foundation: evidence methods, claims-not-values, digitized book datasets + interpolation (PSPP_MATERIALS_PLAN.md).

composition.description: Part composition (PART_ARCHETYPES_PLAN.md): components/interfaces with DERIVED levels by separability, promotion as a recorded operation, EBOM/MBOM split, archetypes + design matrices, and the generic role engine (extracted from motors). Material/equation refs are DATA references, never imports.

magnetics.description: Magnetic materials Section A: option catalog with realization ladder, functional role taxonomy (derived viability), theoretical powder designer (MAGNETIC_MATERIALS_PLAN.md).

motors.description: Electric motors Section C: the M0-M3 ladder of buildable samples (Lavet clock stepper -> reluctance -> ferrite-PM -> dual-stator axial flux), clock control-case sim, torque curves, torque_parity (MAGNETIC_MATERIALS_PLAN.md).

gears.description: Gear trains as data (GEARS_PLAN.md): the gear-type taxonomy with ratio laws + literature efficiency bands + how each type would be MADE in our stack, and the abstract kinematic solve over a shaft-node/mesh-edge graph (speeds with direction, torque after the efficiency chain, power conservation, accumulated backlash). Motor splice = gr-5.

meshassets.description: License-GATED external mesh catalog: verified open-source 3D assets as pointers (never vendored bytes), graded by what the licence actually permits (simulate vs redistribute), plus the fit engine that scales a borrowed mesh onto our vector organ definitions and MEASURES the compromise (shape fidelity). Gears are flagged approximation-invalid: an approximate gear does not mesh.

climate.description: Climate Change & Atmosphere: CO2 series as objects (ice-core + instrumental spans), velocity/acceleration fits, graded health thresholds, the coupled indoor/outdoor crossing projection, XPORT ingest for NHANES biomarkers, and the human-history record.

casting.description: Mold nesting: derived negatives, casting chains with derived parity/thermal gates, sprues, fill/demold sims, the nesting wizard. Requires the shape algebra (mathshapes), seed_upsert (composition), the bead model + mold lifecycle (waxprint), wax rankings (waxsupply), and the exotherm/ceramics data (pspp) — admission must order them first (caught live 2026-08-05).

appstore.description: Polari App Store (appstore-1): installable native shells over the polariapps content layer — catalog/identity, one-time enrollment tokens (hashed at rest), overlaid Gradle source archives + prebuilt binaries from MinIO.

islemesh.description: isle-mesh convergence (mac-1): the polari-side acceptor for isle-mesh data — devices/uplinks/mesh-apps/protocol-permits ingested from the isle agent's registry.json + nginx fragments (isle stays authoritative over networking); mock ingests carry mock_network=true, surfaced as a banner. Feeds /display/isle-mesh and the mac-10 console.

cntfet.description: Aligned-CNT FET S1: decomposed one-tube device, clean-room VS-CNFET-derived compact model (first open CNFET compact model) + ToB F2 reference + Verilog-A/OSDI twin. Compute (OpenVAF/ngspice/OpenSTA/kwant) delegates to the cnt-engines worker (dist-1): CNTFET_ENGINES_URL knob, else topology provider cntfet.engines, else local ~/tools.

microchip.description: Microchip design-level ladder (device -> cell -> block -> core -> chip) + traversal interface. Separable from the device modules: reads cntfet/electrodevice rows softly, imports no device code; absent modules degrade honestly.

computerparts.description: Computer parts + builds as tracked data (ai-8): dated part prices, derived build cost, assembly-feasibility checks over declared specs; feeds the appstore buy-vs-rent advisory (row reads). Seeding imports composition.seed_upsert (guarded) — prices converge on live rows.

computers.description: Computer assembly + use-case profiles as their own app (cmp-c): component taxonomy rows (declared specs + honest gaps), DFA-style assembly gates over the computerparts catalog, profiles as data with ai-6-shaped evidence-bearing fits (db-binding declare-only v1). Separable from the microchip ladder (chip-4 seam deferred).

sifet.description: Silicon MOSFETs (planar / FinFET) on thermal and SOL-GEL dielectrics sharing the cntfet VS device contract (states, regimes, scoring, validity, cross-technology ranking), complementary pairs, and silicon refinement routes (MG -> UMG -> SoG -> EG; PV open, EG novel).

foodstate.description: Food as PSPP state evolution (fsp arc): food stages/processes/evidence methods as pspp rows + property-domain contracts; transform engines arrive fsp-2 (FOOD_STATE_PSPP_PLAN.md).

collab.description: Collaboration sessions (mtg-2, LIVEKIT_COLLABORATION_PLAN v2): one session object, many client surfaces (browser meeting, sim-side voice, VR). CollaborationSession + MeetingRecord rows; KC-verified callers mint short-lived LiveKit JWTs (pure-stdlib HS256 — no SDK); capability/join-info with the *_remote refusal ladder. THE LINE: nothing arriving over LiveKit mutates Polari state. Second module born manifest-first on dyn-1.

reticulum.description: Reticulum mesh transport (ret-1, RETICULUM_TRANSPORT_PLAN): identities/destinations/interfaces/bindings as rows, per-PATH link measurements, ledgered airtime budgets, .arch archipelago with GRADED trust, parent+child state replication, operator-licence assertions + device links. RNS stack lives ONLY in the pol-reticulum sidecar, pinned rns==0.9.4+lxmf==0.6.3 (RETICULUM_LICENCE_GATE.md — pins are licence pins). THE LINE (ret-8): nothing arriving over Reticulum mutates Polari state. Third module born manifest-first on dyn-1.

mqttbridge.description: MQTT bridge: brokers + topic->object bindings as rows, explicit connect, ingest with refusal ledger; publish knob OFF at mqtt-1. paho-mqtt==2.1.0 (EDL-1.0 edge).
